as_told.title: Harrington's months-long briefing: the aliens were 'like day three'

plain: Brent Friedman, a Hollywood figure, retells what a man named John Harrington told him. Friedman says Harrington described being briefed for months, around 1981, in an underground facility in West Virginia, and in a later telling adds that Harrington said seeing the aliens came only around day three. If true, the US government would have run long secret briefings on aliens in a hidden bunker.
